class: TESTED functional layout; not FPS/startup measurement

controls.name: 01 · CHALLENGEBeat the plannerDraw a path from S to G, one cell at a time. Every move costs its length, and a muddy cell costs more to enter (darker is worse). Can you match A*?☆☆☆ · Set your first best

02 · CHALLENGENext nodeA* is part-way through a search. Grey cells are closed; outlined cells are open, each with g (the cost so far) and h (the estimate to G). Click the cell A* expands next -- ten times.☆☆☆ · Set your first best

03 · CHALLENGESearch the baysThe target is in one of four bays, and you know only how likely each one is. Choose the order to look in. You are scored on the expected distance over where it might be -- never on where it turned out to be.☆☆☆ · Set your first best

04 · CHALLENGEMap the arenaDrive COCO to map the arena on wheel odometry alone, within a distance budget. Covering more raises the map's F1; driving further lets the drift grow.☆☆☆ · Set your first best
05 · CHALLENGECase File detectiveA recording of the full ROS 2 stack in Gazebo. Scrub to the moment the robot's belief about where it is first leaves the truth, and mark it.☆☆☆ · Set your first best

06 · DRIVERace the planner's ghostDrive COCO to the flag yourself, at the same speed limits the ghost has. The ghost is the model following A*'s path with a pure-pursuit tracker. Beat its time without hitting more than it does.☆☆☆ · Set your first best
